title: Density at least one on the support inside B_rho(0) under the Allard hypotheses (Simon Ch. 4, 4.9-4.10)
statement: Let n >= 1, l >= 0, p > n, U open in R^{n+l}, V a contract rectifiable n-varifold in U, H : R^{n+l} -> R^{n+l}, and delta, rho real numbers with AllardHypotheses H p delta rho (rho > 0, V has generalized mean curvature H in U, theta >= 1 mu-a.e., 0 in spt V, B_rho(0) contained in U, mu(B_rho(0)) <= (1+delta) omega_n rho^n, (rho^{p-n} integral_{B_rho(0)} |H|^p dmu)^{1/p} <= delta). Then for every y in spt V with |y| < rho and every eps > 0 there is s_0 > 0 such that mu(B_s(y)) >= (1 - eps) omega_n s^n for all s in (0, s_0) (stated as the eventual inequality ofReal((1 - eps) omega_n s^n) <= mu(B_s(y)) along s -> 0+; B_s(y) closed, omega_n = unitBallVolume n).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ p : ℝ, (n : ℝ) < p → ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (δ ρ : ℝ), V.AllardHypotheses H p δ ρ → ∀ y ∈ V.support ∩ ball (0 : Amb n ℓ) ρ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - ε) * (unitBallVolume n * s ^ n)) ≤ V.weight (closedBall y s)
